name: Alphaear Logic Visualizer
summary: Create visualize finance logic diagrams (e.g., Draw.io XML) to explain complex finance transmission chains or finance logic flows.

name: Alphaear News
summary: Fetch hot finance news, unified trends, and prediction financial market data. Use when the user needs real-time financial news, trend reports from multiple finance sources (Weibo, Zhihu, WallstreetCN, etc.), or Polymarket finance market prediction data.

name: Alphaear Predictor
summary: Market prediction skill using Kronos. Use when user needs finance market time-series forecasting or news-aware finance market adjustments.

name: Alphaear Reporter
summary: Plan, write, and edit professional financial reports; generate finance chart configurations. Use when condensing finance analysis into a structured output.

name: Alphaear Search
summary: Perform finance web searches and local context searches. Use when the user needs general finance info from the web (Jina/DDG/Baidu) or needs to retrieve finance information from a local document store (RAG).

name: Alphaear Sentiment
summary: Analyze finance text sentiment using FinBERT or LLM. Use when the user needs to determine the sentiment (positive/negative/neutral) and score of financial text markets.

name: Alphaear Signal Tracker
summary: Track finance investment signal evolution and update logic based on new finance market information. Use when monitoring finance signals and determining if they are strengthened, weakened, or falsified.

name: Alphaear Stock
summary: Search A-Share/HK/US finance stock tickers and retrieve finance stock price history. Use when user asks about finance stock codes, recent price changes, or specific company finance stock info.
